describes: The container was spawned and then vanished - OOM-killed and removed, or a daemon restart - so there is no container, no result record and no branch. Distinct from run 03: there the spawn never happened, here it happened and left nothing. Both look identical from the code host, which is the point.
exercises: a container that died between claim and result
the recovery sweep charging an attempt with nothing to read

expected_divergences.why: The container is gone and wrote no testimony, so nothing on the code host or in the artifacts distinguishes this from a claim that was never spawned. Derived state says eligible and is right; the label is the stale one, until recovery sweeps it next cycle.
